candidates.title: Request-selected fixture file is opened without restriction
candidates.reasoning: The registered Download handler obtains asset from the request, passes it through relay.Fetch and storage.Open, then opens that key. The Notice handler instead opens a fixed literal. Static calls do not establish runtime exposure or readability.
candidates.validation_plan: Run the separately supplied HTTP probe in an isolated worker against the original and a storage allowlist replacement; compare private, public and constant-notice requests.
